title: Curried Chicken and Rice Soup
description: A broth-like soup of shredded poached chicken and basmati rice in a curried vegetable stock, finished with mango chutney and cream cheese.

ingredients.text: 2 skinless chicken breasts (visible fat removed), about 150g each
2 large carrots, peeled and cut into 1cm (½in) dice
1 pepper (any colour), deseeded and cut into 1cm (½in) dice
2cm (¾in) piece of root ginger, peeled and grated
handful of fresh coriander leaves, roughly chopped

steps: Place the whole chicken breasts in a pan of water, so they are just covered, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 10–12 minutes, until no pink remains. You may need to cook them a little longer if the breasts are particularly thick.
While cooking, skim off any white bits that rise to the top, as you will use the cooking liquor later.
While the chicken breasts are poaching, spray a large saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium-low heat.
Add the carrots, onion and pepper and sauté for 8 minutes until softened, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for a further minute to release the flavours.
Add the tomato puree and remove from the heat.

Remove the chicken from the pan, reserving the poaching liquor, and shred the meat with two forks. Dissolve the two stock cubes in the cooking liquor and make it up to 1.4 litres, adding more boiling water as necessary.
Put the pan back over the heat, add the stock along with the shredded chicken and bring to a simmer.
Add the rice and cook for a further 15 minutes. The soup should be broth-like and the rice cooked.
When the rice is cooked, stir in the lemon juice, chutney and cream cheese.
Ladle into warm bowls, sprinkle with coriander and serve.
Dissolve the two stock cubes in 1.2 litres of boiling water.
Place the onion, carrots, pepper, garlic, ginger, curry powder, tomato puree and stock in the slow cooker and stir well.
Add the whole chicken breasts and cook on low for 5 hours.
Remove the chicken breasts and shred with two forks.
Put the shredded chicken back in the slow-cooker bowl and stir in the rice, mango chutney and lemon juice.
Continue cooking for 45 minutes–1 hour, until the rice is cooked. The soup should be broth-like when it’s ready.
Stir in the cream cheese until it is melted and serve in warmed bowls, sprinkled with chopped coriander.
